name: phil/bulk-actions
description: Change thousands of records safely from an admin list: server-side selection, per-field edits, preview, per-item voters and versions, chunked runs, retries.

suggest.phil/audit-bundle: To record who ran which bulk action on how many items, through the AuditTrail port
suggest.phil/outbox: To record an action's effects outside the database under each item's idempotency key
suggest.phil/trash-bundle: To make a bulk delete a move to the trash
suggest.symfony/messenger: To execute the runs chunk by chunk in a worker, with ExecuteBulkRunHandler
